actually-smart-contracts.title: Actually Smart Contracts
actually-smart-contracts.desc: A contract written in words that an AI jury rules on, with pinned evidence and exits that settle exactly.
actually-smart-contracts.status: Built: CORE-001 and onward. The format is versioned; old `swarm.asc/0` contracts still validate.

harness.title: A harness
harness.desc: One AI model wrapped with everything a validator needs: intake, context checks, a signer, a bond, a runtime and a routing agent.
harness.status: Built and run live with five different models (JURY-001, measured Nov 6, 2026).

jury.title: Juries, commit and reveal
jury.desc: How a jury of harnesses from different model families rules: drawn from the beacon, commit first, reveal second, agreement against a bar.
jury.status: Built and verified with live models (JURY-001, JURY-002). The same flow runs on Solana in the verafy_ruling program (SOL-002, local validator).

model-families.title: Open-weight models and model families
model-families.desc: Any open-weight model from Hugging Face can sit on a jury. Diversity is counted by model family: the base model a model descends from.

agreement-and-the-bar.title: Agreement and the bar
agreement-and-the-bar.desc: A ruling passes only when enough independent jurors agree; below the bar, nothing is decided and the contract escalates.
agreement-and-the-bar.status: Built (CORE). The Solana program counts agreement the same way, in parts per million.

proof-of-judgment.title: Proof of Judgment
proof-of-judgment.desc: The record that makes a ruling checkable: who sat, what each committed and revealed, and the exit that ran.

context-is-evidence.title: Context is evidence
context-is-evidence.desc: Nothing in a contract's context can instruct a juror. Instructions found in evidence are reported as evidence.

exits-and-tinysvm.title: Exits and TinySVM
exits-and-tinysvm.desc: The AI chooses an exit; TinySVM runs it with exact integer arithmetic that every node can re-run.
exits-and-tinysvm.status: Built (SETTLE). TinySVM as the default runtime waits on Rex.

verafy-chain.title: Verafy Chain
verafy-chain.desc: A chain whose blocks are rulings: nodes hold funded contracts, draw juries and seal blocks; harnesses do the judging.
verafy-chain.status: Built as a prototype devnet (CHAIN). Not a running network.

solana-settlement.title: Settling on Solana
solana-settlement.desc: The verafy_ruling program runs commit, reveal and the Ruling account on Solana today, with no validator changes.
solana-settlement.status: Built and run on a local test validator (SOL-002, measured Nov 6, 2026). Devnet deployment needs about 1 devnet SOL.

light-client.title: The light client
light-client.desc: How a harness reads other chains: several independent sources that must agree, never one RPC.
light-client.status: Built for Solana (LIGHT); Ethereum through Helios waits on Rex.

routing-agent.title: The routing agent
routing-agent.desc: The part of a harness that holds keys and pays bills: keyblock, payment wallet, API router and the Banker.

banker.title: The Banker
banker.desc: A deterministic service, not an AI agent, that turns deposits in any allowed token into the target token, with every step recorded.
banker.status: Built (BANK-006, 008, 010, 011); venues quote live, execution untested on a funded wallet (BANK-007).

api-credits.title: API credits
api-credits.desc: How a harness keeps its model accounts funded, and why most top-ups are still manual.
api-credits.status: Built: balance reading and planning (BANK-013). Automatic top-ups wait on provider support.

coin-free.title: Coin-free
coin-free.desc: Why there is no coin, and how harnesses get paid without one.
coin-free.status: A rule, enforced in the spec and the Constitution.

assurance-levels.title: Assurance levels
assurance-levels.desc: L0 to L3: how much proof a contract asks for, from a plain jury to proofs of inference.
assurance-levels.status: L0 to L2 routing built (BANK-005); L2 proofs work end to end with a mock prover (PROVE).

proof-of-inference.title: Proofs of inference
proof-of-inference.desc: A cryptographic proof that a specific model produced a specific answer to a specific prompt.
proof-of-inference.status: The flow is built and tested with a mock prover (PROVE-001 to 003). No real proof has been made yet (PROVE-006 needs a GPU and two licenses).

proof-packing.title: Proof packing
proof-packing.desc: Break contracts into small questions, merge the ones they share, and prove each 1,024-token window once.
proof-packing.status: Built end to end in the harness with a mock prover (PACK-011, `verafy packed`). Chain intake does not use it yet.

atoms-and-plans.title: Atoms and plans
atoms-and-plans.desc: The small questions proof packing works with, and the exact rule that composes them.

multi-model-routing.title: Multi-model routing
multi-model-routing.desc: Start every question at the cheapest tier that can answer it safely, and move up only on disagreement.
multi-model-routing.status: Built (ROUTE-001 to 006). Not yet wired into the chain intake (ROUTE-008).

fast-screens-and-calibration.title: Fast screens and calibration
fast-screens-and-calibration.desc: A fast model may settle a question only where its accuracy is proven, per kind of question, and the proof is rechecked live.
fast-screens-and-calibration.status: Built (ROUTE-004, ROUTE-007 partial). A Jev run needs Jev access.

disclosed-reasoning.title: Disclosed reasoning
disclosed-reasoning.desc: Where a juror's reasoning is kept, what it costs to store, and what goes on chain.

audits-and-challenges.title: Audits and challenges
audits-and-challenges.desc: How a sealed ruling is re-checked, and how it can be overturned.
audits-and-challenges.status: Built (JURY-004, JURY-005). Challenge bonds are planned.

constitution-and-ethics.title: The Constitution and the ethics gate
constitution-and-ethics.desc: What Verafy will never rule on, and how every contract is screened before its jury.
constitution-and-ethics.status: Built (GOV-001 to 004). Panel sizes and fees are illustrative until Rex sets them.

encrypted-queue.title: The encrypted queue
encrypted-queue.desc: Contracts wait sealed until their jury is drawn, so nobody can front-run a ruling.

harness-daemon.title: The harness daemon
harness-daemon.desc: The long-running process that keeps a harness online: register, watch, commit, reveal, prove.

launching-a-harness.title: Launching a harness
launching-a-harness.desc: Every way to run one: this machine, Docker, DigitalOcean, Hetzner, any cloud, or a one-click button.
launching-a-harness.status: Built (DEPLOY-001 to 009); cloud creation tested against fake APIs only. Hosted harnesses run by Verafy are planned.

local-testnet.title: A local testnet
local-testnet.desc: A whole testnet on one machine, with scripted AI so it costs nothing, and optional Solana settlement.
local-testnet.status: Built (DEPLOY-007), measured on one machine Nov 6, 2026.

economics.title: The economics
economics.desc: What a ruling costs, where the money goes, and why packing and routing matter.
economics.status: Built (ECON). The calculator is live on the economics page.

jury-scheduler.title: The jury scheduler
jury-scheduler.desc: The one place that decides who sits on a jury, when each step is due, and what happens when a juror does not show.
jury-scheduler.status: Built (CONS-001); the local testnet runs every jury through it.

randomness-beacon.title: The randomness beacon
randomness-beacon.desc: Jury seeds that no block sealer can steer: a hash chain each sealer fixes in advance.

operators.title: Operators
operators.desc: Model families keep one model's blind spots from deciding. Operators keep one owner from holding several seats.
operators.status: Built in the draw (CONS-003); defaults wait on Rex.

bonds-and-slashing.title: Bonds and slashing
bonds-and-slashing.desc: Running a harness means posting a bond that can be taken for misbehavior. What each fault costs, and where the money goes.

challenge-window.title: The challenge window and challenge bonds
challenge-window.desc: Payouts wait until a ruling can no longer be overturned cheaply, so an overturn moves money, not just the record.

judiciary-signer.title: The Judiciary Signer
judiciary-signer.desc: A Squads member no person holds a key for, voting only as a sealed jury ruling says.
judiciary-signer.status: Built: SIGN-001. Measured on a local validator against Squads v4.

policies.title: Policies and Covenant Launch
policies.desc: Rules a wallet cannot break, intent a jury reads, and Covenant Launch for token creators.

model-certification.title: Model certification
model-certification.desc: Closed models judge a wallet only with measured results on the judiciary attack suite.
model-certification.status: Built: SIGN-003. No closed model measured yet.

harness-registry.title: The harness registry
harness-registry.desc: Register a harness on Solana, get discovered with one RPC call, and get paid per case.
harness-registry.status: Built: NET-001. Measured on a local validator.

hardware-attestation.title: Hardware attestation
hardware-attestation.desc: Prove a harness runs a known build inside an AMD SEV-SNP enclave, with its key bound in.
hardware-attestation.status: Verification built: NET-002. No enclave run yet.

bias-profiles.title: Bias profiles
bias-profiles.desc: How a model leans when it judges, measured with paired probes, mapped, and checked by unannounced probes.
bias-profiles.status: Built: SIGN-006. No real model profiled yet.

encoder.title: The encoder
encoder.desc: Policies and contracts on Solana in full, read back against their hash, through IQ Labs Code-In or Memo.

asset-transfer-records.title: Asset transfer records
asset-transfer-records.desc: Sell a physical item, have a jury check the delivery photos, and issue records of the transfer.

commission-covenant.title: The commission covenant
commission-covenant.desc: A validator bonds its promise not to raise commission; code pays stakers if it does.
commission-covenant.status: Built: SIGN-005. Measured on a local validator.
